_doc: HRI combination weights. NOT hardcoded in hri_engine.py. 'source' is 'heuristic-default' for these documented hand-set values; eval/fit_weights.py overwrites this file with source='logreg-fitted', a learned 'scale'/'bias', and fitted per-feature weights. HRI = sigmoid(scale * sum_i(w_i * feature_i) + bias). For the heuristic defaults scale=10, bias=-3 reproduce the legacy shifted-sigmoid; a fitted file will typically set scale=1 and fold magnitude into the weights + bias.

prompt_risk._doc: Stage 1 prompt-risk aggregation: PR = sigmoid(scale * sum(w_i*s_i) + bias). Heuristic defaults; loadable for fitting.
